title: LCA Presents: Ella Mae Dixon
seo_title: LCA Presents: Ella Mae Dixon in Lebanon, MO
description: This is a live music performance by Ella Mae Dixon, presented by LCA. She is drawn to the music of a bygone era, giving new energy to old melodies while paying homage to the styles of yesterday. It takes place Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 7:00 PM at the Cowan Civic Center, 500 East Elm Street in Lebanon, MO.
